pages.title: Skills
pages.one: Everything your helpers get here, in one list, with a switch to turn each one off for this workspace only.

steps.text: Lists what helpers get: skills, instructions, connected services and logins
steps.detail: From four places: comes with orch, this workspace, shared by the admin, or this computer. Names and short texts only, never a key.

steps.text: You look at the Skills page and turn one off or on
steps.detail: Only a person can: when a helper tries the same command it is refused.

steps.text: Switches it off for this workspace only

branch.if: orch's own or a shared skill
branch.then: orch stops linking it here; its files stay

branch.if: a workspace or computer skill, or a service
branch.then: orch writes its own line in the helper tool's switch for this folder

branch.if: the tool has no such switch yet
branch.then: the row says the tool still sees it

steps.text: Helpers that start after that do not get it
You delete a skill you no longer want, or restore it from the Bin
steps.detail: Delete copies the skill into the Bin and checks the copy before the old folder goes. Restore never replaces a skill that has the same name now.

steps.text: Writes every change in the history, with who did it

good: Off never deletes: turning it on again brings back exactly what was there.
No AI call: the list and the switches are a program on this computer.

cmds: what helpers get here, with their ids

files: orch's and shared skills turned off here
